_help: Fill every <...> value; the loader refuses to run while any is left. Keys starting with _ are comments. See the framework README.
_optional: Keys the runbook adds later, all optional and documented in mseo/schema/customer.v2.json: accounts.google_ads.scripts_sheet_id (the Ads report Sheet), accounts.business_profile.check and identity_override (until the Manager grant), site_audit.psi_key_env and site_audit.indexnow_key, ads.negative_seed_list (a file under templates/ads/negatives/, default generic).

business.name: <Business name>
brand_terms: <regex for the business name, e.g. \bacme dental\b>

identity.chrome_profile: <Chrome profile signed in as the identity>

never: <regex for a phrase never to use>

content._industry: Industry vocabulary (claim patterns, sensitive terms, business nouns, brands, topics) lives in this file, never in framework code; the framework's vocabulary lint fails if it leaks in.
content.sensitive_reason: <why these terms are risky on this platform, e.g. financial-services classifier>
